reason: Open till midnight with 70 seats and Wi-Fi is exactly what my friends and I look for at night, so I'd try it a couple of times if someone suggests it. But on my budget I'd order the cheapest thing, like a Turkish coffee or a medium Americano, and stretch it over three hours.
objection: I didn't even know there was a cafe in this complex, and an office building at 9pm could feel dead and corporate, not like a place to hang out. Plus 3.50 for a Spanish latte adds up fast when I only have a few dinars a week for going out.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing photos or hearing from friends that it actually has a good evening crowd and comfortable seating, maybe with a student deal or shisha-free chill vibe after 7pm.
